title: fix(objectql): defer the first lifecycle sweep one interval on a datastore this boot created

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHwNYAiJoiu2ymqfmWX9z1V)_

domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：全新建好的数据库，开机 60 秒那次生命周期清扫（保留期读取、表计数、悬空引用审计）不再跑，推迟一个周期（默认一小时）再扫；已有数据的库照旧 60 秒首扫。
- 为什么改：新库里没有任何一行早于这次开机，最短保留窗口是一小时，首扫注定什么都删不掉，却在 cloud 托管内核上花掉第一分钟 160 条语句里的 130 条。
- 风险与回滚：只改调度器的首次触发，直接调用 sweep() 照扫；最坏情况是新库的过期行晚一个周期被清，回滚即还原 lifecycle-service.ts 一处判断。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts` 的 `start()` 与 `firstSweepDueAtInitialDelay()`；再看同目录测试文件末尾 `LifecycleService timers` 里的四个 #29918 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.test.ts -t 29918`，预期 4 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。卡的条目 1（持久化最后清扫时间，让重启也省掉首扫）另待裁定，本 PR 不关卡。

Refs #29918 (item 2). Item 1, the persisted last-swept watermark, is not in this PR and waits on a decision (report 6646684881 on the card), so this PR does not close the card.

## What changes

- `LifecycleService.start()` now asks, when the initial delay fires, whether the first sweep is due yet (`firstSweepDueAtInitialDelay()`). It is not due when the engine reports that this process created its datastore from empty: `ObjectQL.wasDatastoreCreatedFromEmpty()`, which answers from every driver's schema-sync stats, in process and without issuing a statement. In that case the scheduled first sweep is skipped, and the interval is armed as before, so the first sweep runs one interval later.
- `LifecycleEngineLike` gains the optional member `wasDatastoreCreatedFromEmpty?(): boolean`. The real engine already has it. An engine that omits it, or whose answer throws, is treated as not fresh and keeps the old schedule.
- The gate sits on the scheduler's first tick, not at the entry of `sweep()`. Direct `sweep()` callers (the dogfood growth gate, `db:clean`-style tooling, and more than a dozen suites in objectql, service-knowledge, service-queue and service-messaging that call it on purpose) keep sweeping. The reference audit is a leg of `sweep()` with no timer of its own (`auditReferences()`; its only other caller is the CLI's orphan-detail sweep), so it is deferred with the same tick.
- `OS_LIFECYCLE_DISABLED`, `enabled: false`, `initialDelayMs` and `sweepIntervalMs` keep their meaning. One changeset, `patch` on `@objectstack/objectql`.

## Why

A fresh store holds only rows this process wrote, so none is older than the initial delay (60 s), and the duration grammar's smallest window is one hour (`parseLifecycleDuration`). The first sweep on such a store therefore cannot reap anything. The card measured it on cloud's hosted tenant composition as 130 statements in the 50 to 60 s slice of a first boot (17 retention reads, 16 counts, the reference audit and the governance settings reads). Deferring it costs at most one interval of overstay, which the hourly cadence already allows any row.

## Tests

Four cases added to the existing `LifecycleService timers` describe in `lifecycle-service.test.ts`. Each counts every data-plane door the sweep reaches: reaps, governance settings reads and the reference audit.

- Fresh store: nothing at the initial delay (0 deletes, 0 audits, 0 settings reads), then one sweep one interval later.
- Store that existed before the boot, or an engine whose answer throws: sweeps at the initial delay as before.
- Direct `sweep()` on a fresh store: still sweeps.
- `OS_LIFECYCLE_DISABLED=1` on a fresh store: nothing is armed.


## Acceptance notes

- Card "Done when", clause 1 (no lifecycle-sweep statements in a fresh kernel's first minute): met for the measured first-boot reading. With this change no statement is issued at all, not even a watermark read. cloud re-measures under cloud#3413.
- Clause 2 (a kernel whose watermark is older than the interval still sweeps) belongs to item 1 and is not met here. A re-boot on an existing store still sweeps at the initial delay. Item 1 has no existing persistence seam that needs neither a new config key nor a new `sys_*` object, so the seat sends it to a decision.
- Deviation from the seat's note: the seat asked for the gate at the entry of `sweep()`. It sits on the scheduler's first tick instead, because a gate at the entry would stop every direct `sweep()` caller from sweeping on a fresh store. The reference audit is still deferred, since it only runs inside `sweep()`.

## Verification

All readings on head `07cef192` (after one merge of `origin/main`), in the worktree, with the dependency closure built.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lifecycle/`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 135 passed (135).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 548 passed (548), Tests 10867 passed (10867), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Derived gate list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 59 families, 58 run and exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs the whole workspace built) and is left to CI. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone, then exit 0 (48 cases) after fetching the commit its fixture reads. `--ran` reconciliation: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".

<details><summary>Ablation of the freshness gate</summary>

Committed fix first (`027c6689`), then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `if (this.firstSweepDueAtInitialDelay()) void this.sweep();` with an unconditional `void this.sweep();` plus a marker comment (anchor 1 to 0, blob `026c59ebf9a8` to `f36281d0bba1`) and ran `vitest run src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.test.ts -t 29918`:

```
× [#29918] issues no sweep at the initial delay on a store this boot created, and sweeps one interval later
Tests  1 failed | 3 passed | 114 skipped (118)
```

Restore: blob after restore `026c59ebf9a8` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The other three cases stay green under the mutation, as they should: they pin the unchanged paths. The suite imports the service from source by relative path, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the exported `LifecycleEngineLike` gains the optional member `wasDatastoreCreatedFromEmpty?(): boolean` (an engine without it keeps the old schedule); no accept set changes.
Metadata-protocol: none
